hookups.source: https://www.register.forsythco.com/forsythcounty/discover/facility/0257d4fb-53bc-4c13-bc8c-11ac304730bc (Amenities: 'Water and electric hookups (50 amp)'; campground rules: 'The discharge of gray or black water (sewage) is prohibited. Please use the dump station.'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 73 bookable sites, each with a stated maximum RV length of 19-55 ft (only one under 25 ft), five of them ADA sites. Up to 8 people and 3 vehicles a site; one RV per site, tents on the designated pad (two at most).

sites.source: https://www.register.forsythco.com/forsythcounty/reservation/campgrounds/0257d4fb-53bc-4c13-bc8c-11ac304730bc (site list, e.g. 'Baldridge - Site #3 (maximum RV length 55')', 'ADA Site #62 (maximum RV length 33')'; 73 sites, lengths 19-55 ft); facility page ('Accommodation for up to 3 vehicles and 8 people'); campground rules PDF (one camper or motor home per site, two tents), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.register.forsythco.com/forsythcounty/discover/facility/0257d4fb-53bc-4c13-bc8c-11ac304730bc (Amenities: 'Bathhouses with hot showers', 'Dump station', 'Boat ramp with courtesy dock', 'Playground', 'Swimming beach'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: The county says it 'will close for the 2026 season December 13'; no opening date is published.

season.source: https://www.register.forsythco.com/forsythcounty/discover/facility/0257d4fb-53bc-4c13-bc8c-11ac304730bc ('Bald Ridge Campground will close for the 2026 season December 13.'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Forsyth County Parks & Recreation's own booking site; an account is needed. 'Reservations are required to camp. Reservations must be made at least one day in advance.' No more than 14 days in any 30. A site is held until noon the day after arrival, then cancelled as a no-show. Cancel 48+ hours ahead for a refund less a 10% fee.

booking.source: https://www.register.forsythco.com/forsythcounty/discover/facility/0257d4fb-53bc-4c13-bc8c-11ac304730bc ('Please note that reservations are required to camp. Reservations must be made at least one day in advance.', '2-night minimum is required for weekends and holidays'); campground information PDF ('Staying longer than 14 days within a 30-consecutive-day period is prohibited', no-show and cancellation rules); reservation page ('Min: 1 night, Max: 2 weeks', 'Create an account or log in to reserve a campsite'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $30 a night for every site (water and 50-amp electric). Read 2026-10-29.

fees.source: https://www.register.forsythco.com/forsythcounty/reservation/campgrounds/0257d4fb-53bc-4c13-bc8c-11ac304730bc (all 73 sites '$30.00 / night', Oct 29 - Nov 14 2026 view), read 2026-10-29

values.note: America the Beautiful Annual/Lifetime Senior, Access and Golden Access passes accepted (photo ID at check-in), one site per pass holder, whole stay.

summary: Forsyth County's booking site: 73 sites, water + 50 A, per-site max RV 19-55 ft (72 take 23 ft), all $30; showers, dump, beach, boat ramp; reservations required 1+ day ahead, 2-night weekend/holiday minimum, 14 nights in 30; closes for 2026 on Dec 13; ATB Senior/Access accepted. All groups were unset. AWH note kept verbatim (still accurate). Pin OK.
